== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Bossk with Mortar Gun (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Bossk_With_Mortar_Gun.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-bosskwithmortargun-pre.gif]]) show the original text; the Master List reprints it.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit'. Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1281_4</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
